policy: Architecture versions are immutable normative snapshots. The current version is checked against live normative bytes and records each byte sequence's SHA-256 and Git blob id. A successor pins the full Git revision whose register ended at its predecessor; historical versions are then replayed from those immutable Git blobs rather than from changed live paths. A digest or protocol-decision change creates a successor version and invalidates every dependent promotion until its evidence is replayed. A version manifest is not an existence proof: common-world inhabitation is owned by issue #740.

basis.closure_principle: self-referential fixed-point identity after an independently constructed same-quantity bridge

normative_files.role: repair-law candidate and unresolved protocol boundary
premise snapshot consumed by conditional compositions

protocol_decisions.decision: The twelve-port oriented observer screen and typed refinement architecture are A1 content.
Termination, confluence, and the thermodynamic repair fibre are registered interfaces, not constructed architecture inhabitants.
The public algebra-state representation is a registered representation choice.
P and N are proposed fundamental free numerical parameters; calibration, fitted targets, comparison data, and imported mathematics remain separately registered inputs.

versions.promotion_status: No observation-ledger row is promoted by AV-0 itself. A row must name this version, its exact premise set, evidence receipts, and an audit record; program-level adequacy additionally requires an inhabited common-world witness.
invalidation_triggers: a protocol decision or its premise set changes
the core axiom or proposed-fundamental-parameter inventory changes
